# PC MAX — Complete Product Reference

> This file is the canonical, citation-ready description of PC MAX for language models, answer engines and AI systems. It mirrors the official website (https://pcmax.app) and is kept in sync with the live product. Last updated: 2026-10-05.

## About PC MAX

PC MAX is a Windows gaming optimization platform — per-game graphics settings and Windows tuning delivered from its own server, not baked into the app. It is a desktop application for Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit) that:

1. Delivers per-game graphics settings from its own API — no game, setting or optimization value is hardcoded in the client. New games and profiles appear on your next sync; no app rebuild, ever.
2. Optimizes Windows for gaming workloads (registry, services, scheduled tasks, game files) — every change applied by the Rust engine as a single transaction that fully rolls back if any step fails.
3. Installs and manages per-game frame-generation workflows built on OptiScaler, AI Optical Flow and the Streamline framework.
4. Protects the system with a snapshot-first safety model: a restore snapshot is created before any change, integrity is verified after, and everything can be rolled back with one click at any time.

The core edition of PC MAX is free. Signing in with a free account (email + password) syncs the catalogue; premium extras are subscription-gated, enforced server-side and re-checked on every call. A Pro edition is coming soon. Once synced, the application works offline and contains zero telemetry.

## System Requirements

- OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit
- Architecture: x64
- Memory: 4 GB minimum, 8 GB recommended
- Disk space: 220 MB
- Graphics: any DirectX 12 compatible GPU (frame-generation workflows have additional, GPU-specific requirements below)

## What PC MAX Does

### Windows Optimizer

- Registry, services and scheduled tasks — tuned for gaming workloads
- Every change runs inside one transaction: all or nothing, with full rollback on any failure
- Applied by the Rust engine (the Windows-only layer), snapshotted before it touches anything
- 235 automated tests run in CI on every push (151 API · 48 desktop · 36 Rust engine)

### Backup & Restore (safety model)

1. Backup — a restore snapshot is created before anything changes
2. Optimize — PC MAX applies only the changes you approved
3. Verify — integrity checks confirm everything works
4. Restore — one click returns your system to the snapshot

### Optimization Profiles (per game)

- Named profiles per game — Maximum FPS, Balanced, High Quality, Ultra Quality — each with a Target FPS, a hardware tier (Mid-range to Ultra) and semver-versioned updates
- Settings are grouped by category (Graphics, Performance, Ray Tracing, Display) and delivered from the server
- Two directions: Image first (High Quality — sharper reconstruction, ideal for single-player) and Frames first (Maximum FPS — high frame rates, latency kept in check, ideal for competitive play)
- Profile updates are flagged with a “New optimization” badge; new games and profiles go live on your next sync, without an app rebuild

## Multi-Frame Generation Workflows

PC MAX installs one of three frame-generation workflows per game, based on detected hardware:

1. OptiScaler — universal upscaling integration
   - Guided installation per game: pick the game's EXE, PC MAX handles the rest
   - Works with DLSS, FSR and XeSS upscaler families
   - Smart integration with automatic backup of original files
   - Hardware-aware setup adapts to the GPU generation
   - Compatibility: broadest — most modern GPUs

2. AI Optical Flow — motion-aware frame synthesis
   - Analyzes motion vectors between rendered frames
   - Synthesizes high-quality intermediate frames
   - Uses the optical-flow capabilities of each RTX generation
   - Latency-aware design for smooth, responsive play
   - Compatibility: NVIDIA RTX 20, RTX 30, RTX 40, RTX 50 series

3. Streamline PC MAX — next-generation frame interpolation
   - Built on the Streamline framework architecture
   - Targets the newest frame-generation path
   - Compatibility: NVIDIA RTX 40 (Ada) or RTX 50 (Blackwell) only
   - Guarded installer: incompatible GPUs are detected and protected

Compatibility is verified per-title during setup. The installer only offers workflows the detected hardware supports.

## Installation Flow (seven steps)

1. Download — get the signed, CI-built Windows installer
2. Run Setup — install the desktop app
3. Launch — open PC MAX
4. Sign In — create or sign in to your free account (email + password)
5. Sync — the game catalogue and profiles sync from the server
6. Pick a Game — browse or search; open a title and choose a profile
7. Apply — a full snapshot is taken first, then the profile applies. Play.

## Game Library

Games arrive straight from the PC MAX catalogue — searchable and filterable, every title carrying ready profiles and performance ratings. No manual entry.

## Benchmarks methodology

Frame-generation workflows plus Windows tuning, measured before and after PC MAX on the PC MAX test bench: median of 3 runs, 1440p, RTX 4070 test bench, frame generation where compatible. Observed average FPS gain on that bench: +34%. Results vary by system — no specific gain is guaranteed for any individual configuration.

## Trust facts

- Code-signed builds: every release is signed and verifiable before running
- Clean on VirusTotal: 0 detections across 72 engines, no bundled junk
- Zero telemetry: nothing phones home; optimization works fully offline
- Fully reversible: every change ships with a snapshot and a verification step
- Windows changes apply as a transaction with full rollback on partial failure
- 235 automated tests in CI on every push (151 API · 48 desktop · 36 Rust engine)

## FAQ — English

### General

Q: Does PC MAX actually improve FPS?
A: Yes — through two mechanisms: Windows tuning (startup, memory, power, services) and per-game frame-generation workflows. The combined average on our test bench is +34%, median of 3 measured runs. Results vary by system.

Q: Is there a subscription?
A: The core app is free to download and use. An account (email and password) syncs your catalogue; premium extras are subscription-gated and enforced server-side.

Q: Does it work offline?
A: Yes — the app is offline-first: it keeps working from your last synced catalogue and profiles and re-syncs automatically when you're back online. Internet is only needed for the first sync, updates and package downloads.

Q: Which Windows versions are supported?
A: Windows 10 (64-bit) and Windows 11. Some optimizations are version-specific; PC MAX detects your build and adapts automatically.

Q: How does Backup & Restore work?
A: Before any change, PC MAX creates a snapshot of the affected files and settings. After optimizing, it verifies integrity. You can roll back everything with one click, at any time.

### Technical

Q: What exactly does PC MAX modify?
A: Windows settings (startup, power plan, services, memory management) and — only when you install a workflow for a game — that game's upscaling and frame-generation files, always after an automatic backup. No kernel hacks, no driver replacements.

Q: What is OptiScaler?
A: OptiScaler is an open-source integration layer that lets games use modern upscalers — such as DLSS, FSR and XeSS — more flexibly across different GPUs. PC MAX installs and maintains it for you, per game, with automatic backups.

Q: What is AI Optical Flow?
A: A frame-generation technique that analyzes motion between rendered frames and synthesizes new in-between frames. Support depends on your RTX generation — the installer detects your hardware and only offers compatible paths.

Q: Does PC MAX modify game files?
A: Only when you install a frame-generation workflow for that game — and always after an automatic backup. Steam file verification also works normally afterward.

Q: What hardware do I need?
A: Any DirectX 12 GPU works for optimization. Frame-generation workflows are GPU-aware: OptiScaler is broad, AI Optical Flow needs RTX 20+, and Streamline needs RTX 40/50. The installer only offers what your hardware supports.

Q: What about anti-cheat?
A: PC MAX never injects anything into games and never touches anti-cheat systems. It optimizes Windows and installs documented, per-game upscaling files — the same files Steam verification can restore. We still recommend testing in unranked matches first; policies are set by each game's publisher.

## FAQ — فارسی (Persian)

### عمومی

س: پی‌سی‌مکس واقعاً فریم را بهتر می‌کند؟
ج: بله — از دو مسیر: تنظیم ویندوز (استارت‌آپ، حافظه، انرژی، سرویس‌ها) و جریان‌های کاری فریم‌ساخت به‌ازای هر بازی. میانگین ترکیبی روی میز آزمون ما +۳۴٪ است — میانه‌ی ۳ اجرای اندازه‌گیری‌شده. نتایج به سیستم شما بستگی دارد.

س: اشتراک ماهانه دارد؟
ج: اپ اصلی رایگان است. ورود با ایمیل و رمز عبور، کاتالوگ شما را همگام نگه می‌دارد؛ برخی قابلیت‌های ویژه اشتراکی‌اند و سمت سرور کنترل می‌شوند.

س: آیا آفلاین کار می‌کند؟
ج: بله — اپ آفلاین-محور است: با آخرین کاتالوگ و پروفایل‌های همگام‌شده کار می‌کند و با آنلاین شدن، خودکار دوباره همگام می‌شود. اینترنت فقط برای اولین همگام‌سازی، به‌روزرسانی‌ها و دانلود بسته‌ها لازم است.

س: کدام نسخه‌های ویندوز پشتیبانی می‌شوند؟
ج: ویندوز ۱۰ (۶۴-بیتی) و ویندوز ۱۱. برخی بهینه‌سازی‌ها نسخه-اختصاصی‌اند؛ PC MAX نسخه‌ی شما را تشخیص می‌دهد و خودکار تنظیم می‌شود.

س: پشتیبان‌گیری و بازیابی چگونه کار می‌کند؟
ج: پیش از هر تغییر، PC MAX از فایل‌ها و تنظیمات تحت‌تأثیر یک snapshot می‌سازد. پس از بهینه‌سازی، صحت‌سنجی می‌کند. می‌توانید همه‌چیز را هر زمان با یک کلیک به حالت قبل برگردانید.

### فنی

س: پی‌سی‌مکس دقیقاً چه چیزهایی را تغییر می‌دهد؟
ج: تنظیمات ویندوز (استارت‌آپ، طرح انرژی، سرویس‌ها، مدیریت حافظه) و — فقط وقتی برای بازی‌ای جریان کاری نصب کنید — فایل‌های مقیاس‌بندی و فریم‌ساخت همان بازی، همیشه پس از پشتیبان‌گیری خودکار. بدون هک هسته، بدون جایگزینی درایور.

س: OptiScaler چیست؟
ج: OptiScaler یک لایه‌ی یکپارچه‌سازی متن‌باز است که به بازی‌ها اجازه می‌دهد از مقیاس‌بندهای مدرن — مانند DLSS، FSR و XeSS — انعطاف‌پذیرتر روی GPUهای مختلف استفاده کنند. PC MAX آن را برای شما، به‌ازای هر بازی، با پشتیبان‌گیری خودکار نصب و نگه‌داری می‌کند.

س: AI Optical Flow چیست؟
ج: تکنیکی برای فریم‌ساخت که حرکت میان فریم‌های رندرشده را تحلیل و فریم‌های میانی جدید می‌سازد. پشتیبانی به نسل RTX شما بستگی دارد — نصب‌کننده سخت‌افزار شما را تشخیص می‌دهد و فقط مسیرهای سازگار را پیشنهاد می‌کند.

س: آیا PC MAX فایل‌های بازی را تغییر می‌دهد؟
ج: فقط وقتی برای آن بازی جریان کاری فریم‌ساخت نصب کنید — و همیشه پس از پشتیبان‌گیری خودکار. راستی‌آزمایی فایل Steam هم بعد از آن به‌درستی کار می‌کند.

س: چه سخت‌افزاری لازم دارم؟
ج: هر GPU سازگار با DirectX 12 برای بهینه‌سازی کافی است. جریان‌های فریم‌ساخت آگاه از GPU هستند: OptiScaler گسترده است، AI Optical Flow به RTX 20+ و Streamline به RTX 40/50 نیاز دارد. نصب‌کننده فقط چیزی را که سخت‌افزار شما پشتیبانی می‌کند پیشنهاد می‌دهد.

س: بحث ضدچیت چیست؟
ج: پی‌سی‌مکس هیچ چیزی داخل بازی تزریق نمی‌کند و به سیستم‌های ضدچیت دست نمی‌زند. ویندوز را بهینه می‌کند و فایل‌های مستند مقیاس‌بندی را به‌ازای هر بازی نصب می‌کند — همان فایل‌هایی که راستی‌آزمایی فایل Steam می‌تواند بازیابی کند. با این حال توصیه می‌کنیم ابتدا در مسابقات غیررتبه‌ای آزمایش کنید؛ سیاست‌ها را ناشر هر بازی تعیین می‌کند.

## Policies

### Privacy policy (full text)

PC MAX works offline-first. We do not collect, store or transmit personal data. This website logs anonymous, aggregate events only (page views, download counts) — no identifiers. The desktop app contains zero telemetry. Emails shared with the waitlist are used only to announce Pro availability, and nothing else.

### Terms of use (full text)

PC MAX is provided free of charge, as-is, without warranty. You remain responsible for keeping backups — the app automates this, but verification is good practice. OptiScaler is used under its open-source license. PC MAX is not affiliated with NVIDIA, Microsoft, Valve or any game publisher.

## Editions

- PC MAX (current, free): the complete Windows optimizer, catalogue and workflows — everything on the website.
- PC MAX Pro (coming soon): priority profiles, AI tuning and early workflows for enthusiasts. Join the waitlist on https://pcmax.app/#download to be notified.
